name: SubjectOfCare
title: Subject of care
description:
The person the records are about: the child whose doses are given, signed, registered, verified and shared. Acts through the caregiver, holds no device and plays no lane in the journeys' processes.

**Persona**: A newborn whose vaccination history must follow him across a border he cannot speak for.

**Also known as**: Patient; Care recipient

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

- ![Somsak](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) [Somsak](personas.html#somsak-baby--the-record-follows-him-onesa), Somsak SENGMANY (newborn)

**In the user scenarios**:

- [J1 — Vaccinated and recorded](scenarios.html#j1--vaccinated-and-recorded-taifafeki-birth-day): J1 A baby from Onesa is born in Taifafeki
- [J2 — Found and registered](scenarios.html#j2--found-and-registered-onesa-somsak-is-7-weeks-old): J2b Registered at home, and referred
- [J4.1 — Continuity across a border: a paediatrician in Taifafeki sees the full history](scenarios.html#j41--continuity-across-a-border-a-paediatrician-in-taifafeki-sees-the-full-history-kesaro-12-months-later): J4.1 A doctor in Taifafeki sees the full history

**On the device screens**: [S1 Birth Abroad & Printed DVC QR Cards (Dr. Anan's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S1/); [S3 Newborn Registration & Clinic Referral (Vilay's phone)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S3/); [S8 Foreign Clinic VHL Viewer & Audit Trace (Dr. Anan's tablet)](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/demo/S8/)

**Discussed in the workshop modules**: [M1 From journey to capabilities](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m1/); [M2 The reference architecture (DPI-H) and where you stand](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m2/); [M4 Trust, credentials and wallets](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m4/); [M5 Governance, decision rights and the legal basis](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m5/); [M6 Doing it together](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m6/); [M7 First move and the investment required](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/m7/); [T1 Building with FHIR and the Open Health Stack](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t1/); [T2 Offline data capture](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t2/); [T3 Trust between countries: SMART Trust and the GDHCN](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t3/); [T4 Workflows, sync and who sees what](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t4/); [T5 From records to charts](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t5/); [T6 Verifying a card, sharing a link](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t6/); [T7 Team build, showcase and the journey together](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/technical-track/t7/)
